blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Find all the antiderivatives for each derivative: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = 100x^4\)
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke sawal kya keh raha hai: humein \(y\) ka derivative diya gaya hai aur \(y\) khud dhoondna hai. Yani differentiation ka ulta kaam, jise antidifferentiation (yani integration) kehte hain.
"All the antiderivatives" ka matlab hai saari family, sirf ek function nahi. Is liye jawab mein \(+\,c\) zaroor aayega.
Rule kaunsa lagega? Constant 100 ko bahar nikalne ke liye Rule 1, aur \(x^4\) ke liye Power Rule (Rule 3).
Plan: integral likhein, constant bahar karein, power rule lagayein, aur aakhir mein differentiate kar ke check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = 100x^4\).
Maloom karna: woh tamam functions \(y\) jin ka derivative \(100x^4\) ho.
Tareeqa: \(y = \int 100x^4\,dx\). Rule 1 se constant bahar aata hai, aur Rule 3 (Power Rule) se \(x^4\) ka integral: power mein 1 jama karo aur nayi power se divide karo. Yeh rule isliye sahi hai ke differentiation mein power neeche aa kar 1 kam hoti hai; integration mein hum bilkul ulta karte hain.

\(y\) ko integral ki shakal mein likhein
\[y = \int 100x^4\,dx\]
\[= 100\int x^4\,dx\]
Kyun: Rule 1, \(\int k f(x)\,dx = k\int f(x)\,dx\). Constant (yahan 100) multiply ho raha ho to usay integral ke bahar le aate hain; is se kaam saaf aur aasaan ho jata hai.

Power Rule lagayein
\[= 100\cdot\dfrac{x^{4+1}}{4+1} + c\]
\[= 100\cdot\dfrac{x^5}{5} + c\]
\[= 20x^5 + c\]
Kyun: Rule 3, \(\int x^n\,dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + c\), yahan \(n = 4\) hai jo \(-1\) nahi, is liye rule chal jata hai. Power 4 se 5 ho gayi aur 5 se divide kiya; phir \(100 \div 5 = 20\).
Dhyan dein: \(+\,c\) bhoolna sab se aam ghalti hai. Sawal "all the antiderivatives" maang raha hai, aur \(c\) hi woh saari family deta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\left(20x^5 + c\right) = 100x^4 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Jawab ko differentiate karein to wahi derivative wapas milna chahiye jo diya gaya tha. \(20 \times 5 = 100\) aur power 5 se 4 ho gayi; constant \(c\) ka derivative zero hai. Is liye jawab bilkul sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(y = 20x^5 + c\), jahan \(c\) koi bhi constant hai (\(c\) ki har value ek naya antiderivative deti hai, jaise \(20x^5\), \(20x^5 + 3\), \(20x^5 - 7\)).

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Find all the antiderivatives for each derivative: \(\frac{dy}{dt} = 2 + 24t^3 - 10t^4\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi wahi qisam ka sawal hai: derivative diya hai aur function \(y\) chahiye. Farq sirf yeh hai ke variable ab \(x\) nahi balke \(t\) hai, is liye hum \(dt\) ke saath integrate karenge.
Right side par teen terms hain, jo plus aur minus se jurre hue hain. Is liye har term ka alag integral lenge.
Rules: Rule 2 (sum aur difference ko tor kar), Rule 1 (constants bahar), aur Rule 3 (Power Rule).
Plan: tor kar integrate karein, aakhir mein sirf ek constant \(c\) likhein, phir differentiate kar ke check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\frac{dy}{dt} = 2 + 24t^3 - 10t^4\).
Maloom karna: \(t\) ke woh tamam functions \(y\) jin ka yeh derivative ho.
Tareeqa: \(y = \int (2 + 24t^3 - 10t^4)\,dt\). Rule 2 se har term alag karenge, Rule 1 se constants bahar, aur har power par Power Rule.

Integral ko term by term torein
\[y = \int 2\,dt + \int 24t^3\,dt - \int 10t^4\,dt\]
\[= 2\int 1\,dt + 24\int t^3\,dt - 10\int t^4\,dt\]
Kyun: Rule 2 kehta hai ke sum ya difference ka integral alag alag integrals ka sum ya difference hota hai. Phir Rule 1 se har constant (2, 24, 10) bahar aa gaya.

Har term ka integral lein
\[= 2t + 24\cdot\dfrac{t^4}{4} - 10\cdot\dfrac{t^5}{5} + c\]
\[= 2t + 6t^4 - 2t^5 + c\]
Kyun: \(\int 1\,dt = t\) hai, kyunke \(t\) ka derivative 1 hota hai. Baqi do terms par Power Rule: \(t^3\) se \(\frac{t^4}{4}\) aur \(t^4\) se \(\frac{t^5}{5}\). Phir \(24 \div 4 = 6\) aur \(10 \div 5 = 2\).
Dhyan dein: har integral ka apna constant hota hai, lekin teen constants mil kar bhi ek hi arbitrary constant bante hain, is liye aakhir mein sirf ek \(c\) likhte hain.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dt}\left(2t + 6t^4 - 2t^5 + c\right)\]
\[= 2 + 24t^3 - 10t^4 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(2t\) ka derivative 2, \(6t^4\) ka \(24t^3\), aur \(-2t^5\) ka \(-10t^4\). Bilkul wahi derivative wapas mil gaya jo sawal mein diya tha.
